textRuns.value: MonitorRaw: raw monitor output in Import mode
This report reads the JSON files that monitor writes and does not call any API. Open Transform data > Edit parameters to configure the source.
SourceType: Local or Blob. Selects where the files are read from.

LocalFolder: absolute path of the folder that contains the module folders (activity, capacity_metrics, gitconnections, ...). Use the LOCAL_OUTPUT_PATH value, or a copy of the container root. Used when SourceType is Local.
BlobAccountUrl and BlobContainer: storage account URL and container name. Used when SourceType is Blob. Sign in with an account that has the Storage Blob Data Reader role.
BlobRootPath: the STORAGE_ACCOUNT_CONTAINER_ROOT_PATH value. Leave empty when the module folders sit at the container root.
Dates come from the <module>/YYYY/MM/DD/ folder layout (UTC), not from file modified times.
Capacity Metrics rows are de-duplicated: the latest run wins per capacity, group and timepoint. Carry-over data exists only for newer Capacity Metrics app versions.
Git connections, tags, delegated settings and widely shared links show the latest snapshot only. They are opt-in monitor modules and stay empty until the module has run.
Files that cannot be parsed appear as rows with a Load Error and are counted below. Missing folders and empty files give empty tables.
